properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated November 12, [1949], on Pan American Airways System stationery, en route from Tokyo to Hong Kong; includes description of incident on November 9 in which Managing Director C.Y. Liu joined with Communist forces in China, taking eleven CNAC aircraft to Peiping [Beijing], Bixby’s and [William L.] Bond’s reaction; mentions General Marquand and Amos Hiatt.
